items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So we were the fortunate ones, your Ray Bryants and Stan Getz, Red Rodney, Jimmy Heath, Coltrane, Philly Joe, and those guys. They made it.

ctx.x: Yeah, life has been good – really been good – very, very good. I’ve been fortunate, because it didn’t have to happen like this. Without those knocks on the door, those opportunities, everything would have been academic. But I did have them. Some people don’t get them. There are guys in Philadelphia that are still there playing, never got that knock on the door. It’s terrible. Then there’s some guys that wanted to play in the worst way – didn’t have the talent. So that was academic. They wanted to play in the…
I think that’s probably the best note to end on.
